name: cola-ok
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE compact playful die-cut paper sticker in this existing series.
REFERENCE ROLES in actual order: Image 1 burger is STYLE ONLY: matte gouache/color-pencil paper grain, narrow white edge, charcoal ink arms and feet, two tiny dark oval eyes and circular coral cheeks. Do not copy burger anatomy. Image 2 is COLA IDENTITY ONLY: preserve the plain warm-red tapered paper drink cup, broad cream rimmed lid, bent cream straw outlined in red like a little antenna, and same facial scale with little charcoal arms/feet. Sunglasses, reclining pose, picnic mat and umbrella shape in Image 2 are temporary trait scene details and MUST NOT recur. Normal cup has two tiny dark oval eyes on red body and one simple bent drinking straw, not an umbrella.
OUTPUT: flat front-facing matte printed paper, narrow continuous white die-cut edge around complete scene, compact centered composition with at least 10% transparent margins; readable at160–240px. Requested1024x1024 PNG with genuine alpha transparency. No text, letters, captions, brands, logo, M, golden arches, watermark, scenery, room, floor shadow, glossy CGI, rubber or toy.
LITTLE STORY: The same cup stands at attention and gives a very serious salute with one charcoal hand. Its cream lid has accidentally slipped diagonally halfway down over one eyebrow, with the bent antenna straw tilting along with the lid. One eye partly covered, the other eye and tiny straight mouth remain solemnly determined. Keep face on red cup body and recognizable cup shape, other arm at its side. One tiny two-stroke surprise accent. No hat or extra drink.
